gaps.sentence: 'I'm sorry I forgot the meeting,' she said. She ___ forgetting the meeting.
gaps.explanation: An apology is reported with 'apologised for + gerund'.

gaps.sentence: 'Get out of my way!' the guard snapped. The guard snapped at me ___ out of my way.
gaps.hint: snap at sb to do sth
gaps.explanation: The order is reported as snapped at me + to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: 'You can rely on me,' she assured me. She assured me that I ___ rely on her.
gaps.explanation: Can backshifts to could after the past reporting verb 'assured'.

gaps.sentence: 'I didn't take your charger,' she insisted. She ___ taking my charger.
gaps.explanation: Denials are reported as deny + -ing: denied taking.

gaps.sentence: 'I've been studying all night,' she said. She said she ___ studying all night.
gaps.hint: present perfect continuous → past perfect continuous
gaps.explanation: have been + -ing backshifts to had been + -ing.

gaps.sentence: The witness ___ the police that he knew nothing.
gaps.explanation: Tell somebody that... — the personal object 'the police' requires told, not said.

gaps.sentence: 'Come round to my house tomorrow,' she said. She invited me round to her house ___.
gaps.explanation: Tomorrow becomes the next day (the following day) when the invitation is reported.

gaps.sentence: 'I will always love you,' he whispered. He whispered that he ___ always love me.
gaps.explanation: Will backshifts to would; 'you' shifts to 'me' from the speaker's new perspective.
